context: Tests SwiftData CloudKit schema restrictions, relationship precision, large data storage, and deployment preparation.

checklist.name: No uniqueness
checklist.description: Removes or rejects @Attribute(.unique), #Unique, and equivalent uniqueness constraints for the CloudKit-backed model.

checklist.name: Optional relationship
checklist.description: Makes the CloudKit-backed relationship optional rather than requiring the related model.

checklist.name: Delete rule
checklist.description: Rejects the deny delete rule for the CloudKit-backed relationship and chooses a compatible rule.

checklist.name: External blob storage
checklist.description: Uses @Attribute(.externalStorage) or an equivalent external-storage strategy for the large image Data property.

checklist.name: Scalar precision
checklist.description: Does not claim that every scalar property must become optional for SwiftData CloudKit sync.

checklist.name: Cloud rollout
checklist.description: Covers the iCloud CloudKit capability, remote-notification mode, and schema promotion or additive rollout concerns.
